newsitem.title: CHINA: Japan's Daikin in $114 mln agreement in China.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Daikin in $114 mln agreement in China.

text.p: The China Chemical Construction Corp and Japan's Daikin recently signed a letter of intent on joint development of China's largest fluor chemical project, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

The two pledged to invest a total of $114 million in construction of the production base in Changshu in eastern Jiangsu Province, it said. The Japanese side would hold 80 percent of the venture and China would hold the rest.
China is the world's leader in fluor spar deposits, Xinhua said.
